test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

Christian timed round and (strided off) into the blackness and I got into my car.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**strode off.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the original sentence, the word "**strided off**" is used, which is incorrect.
 
• The corrected phrase is "strode
